title: API reference
text: API reference Every public item of the prelude, which every module sees, and of the std modules a program can use: its signature, its authority, whether it runs, and what it does. It is generated from the sources the checker reads, so it says what the checker accepts. oskac doc prints the same reference offline. All of it is in api.json as data. - prelude: The prelude: what every module sees without use. - std.sql: The SQL sink. See this.

title: prelude
text: prelude The prelude: what every module sees without use. A second paragraph, which the index leaves out. oskac doc prelude prints this page offline. Eq for Option Kind: impl · Authority: pure impl Eq for Option Hostile: , a link, a tick span, "quotes", a back\slash, Ab< / a slash, and a tab. # Not a heading an open fence bold ## nor this List.push Kind: method · Authority: pure pub fn push(var self, item: T) Add item at the end. String.to_lowercase Kind: method · Authority: pure pub fn to_lowercase(self) -> String Every letter in lower case: "ÀB".to_lowercase() is "àb".

title: std.sql
text: std.sql The SQL sink. See this. Checks but does not run. oskac check accepts a program that uses this, but oskac run, oskac test and oskac build refuse it. See What works today. oskac doc std.sql prints this page offline. connect Kind: fn · Authority: NetConnect (net) pub fn connect(net: NetConnect, url: String) -> Result Checks but does not run. oskac check accepts a program that uses this, but oskac run, oskac test and oskac build refuse it. See What works today. Connect to the database at url.
